verdicts.reading: Half of the work activities of 2021 could be automated by 2025.
verdicts.mainstream_test: D27/D30 possibility rule: 'could' with no stated expectation; under a realised-automation reading the test would be >=45% of activities actually automated by end-2025, under a technical-potential reading the test would be a potential estimate within 10% of 50%.
verdicts.reason: Hedge word 'could'. The slide states a technical potential, not an expected outcome (source line 'McKinsey analysis'). The two plausible readings diverge: realised automation of half of all work activities by 2025 clearly did not happen (miss); technical automation potential of ~50% was already McKinsey's own estimate and was later raised to 60-70% for current technology (hit/partial). Possibility-only under D30 -> unfalsifiable.
